disposition: Six substantive regional economic-history articles were added after checkpoint 351; 315 substantive rewrites/additions and 42 retained teaching flows in total. The batch uses MIT and LSE curricula to add China, Japan, South Asia, Africa, the Middle East and North Africa, and Latin America without treating a region as one policy success story or one recurring crisis.

validation.numeric: China tracks output 100, obligation 60, residual 40 and additional output 10 to residual 50; Japan splits investment 100 into firm funds 20, bank credit 60 and public infrastructure 20; South Asia adds origin price 10, transport 2, tax 1 and loss 1 to arrival price 14 against market price 16; Africa subtracts transport and intermediation 4 and cash tax 10 from cash-crop sales 20 to leave 6; MENA subtracts production and company share 30 and debt service 10 from oil sales 100 to leave government revenue 60, then shows a price-shock shortfall 30; Latin America changes 100-80-10=10 into 80-80-18=-18. Every figure is marked as an explanatory assumption rather than a historical statistic.
